meta.name: carbon-accounting
meta.description: Calculate, track, and report greenhouse gas emissions following GHG Protocol standards, including Scope 1, 2, and 3 emissions and science-based targets. Use when "carbon accounting, GHG emissions, scope 1, scope 2, scope 3, carbon footprint, emission factor, science-based target, SBTi, net zero, " mentioned.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 计算并报告温室气体排放量
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要按GHG Protocol标准核算企业碳排放。
copy.tagline_en: Calculate and report greenhouse gas emissions.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to calculate corporate carbon emissions per GHG Protocol.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude可以按照GHG Protocol标准计算、跟踪和报告温室气体排放，涵盖范围1、2、3排放和科学碳目标。
howto.when: 当用户提到“碳核算”、“温室气体排放”、“范围1”等关键词，或要求计算碳足迹时触发。

say.text: 帮我计算公司今年的范围1碳排放。

howto.what_en: After installing, Claude calculates, tracks, and reports greenhouse gas emissions per GHG Protocol, covering Scope 1, 2, 3 and science-based targets.
howto.when_en: Triggered when user mentions 'carbon accounting', 'GHG emissions', 'Scope 1', or similar keywords, or asks for carbon footprint calculation.

say_en.text: Calculate our company's Scope 1 emissions for this year.
say_en.note: Claude will compute using standard methods.
Claude guides you through target setting.
